why: Repair B landed (LLP 3000.001 #reliability-catchup: a confirmed image may not carry a write the acknowledgements do not — the page carries images_at, the server reports committed_above, and a page whose images hold one of this device's own replayable writes publishes nothing until it does not). Measured 433,908 B gzip on the integrated tree, rounded up to 1000 B, from 410,459 on main. Attributed by ordered source ablation: deferred slot and recording 10,824 B; capture/declaration 6,889 B; restore evidence and observation 1,654 B; wasm opening 1,218 B; shared publication/lifecycle/wire remainder 5,550 B. 2,686 B of reductions were taken before raising (collection choices, combined recording maps); a shared-applicator experiment added 2,640 B and was reverted. The remaining 23,449 B is about 21.3% of the diet's recovered bytes and is tracked for reclamation in issues/20260918-snapback4-repair-b-device-bytes.md. The budget is a ratchet (author ruling 2026-09-18): build-wasm.sh fails above it; a landing that needs bytes raises it in the same commit with the reason here, in its commit message and in the journal.
